# ODE parity corpus (copied from pflow-xyz)

Both files are **byte-identical copies** of the canonical corpus in
[pflow-xyz](https://github.com/pflow-xyz/pflow-xyz) — do not edit them here.

| file | source | what |
|---|---|---|
| `fixtures.json` | `pflow-xyz/parity/ode/fixtures.json` | hand-formatted fixture models, rates and time spans |
| `expected.json` | `pflow-xyz/parity/ode/expected.json` | go-pflow's Tsit5 trajectory for each fixture, generated by `parity/ode/gen` (`make ode-expected` in pflow-xyz) with `solver.DefaultOptions()` |

`expected.json` records the sha256 of the `fixtures.json` it was generated
from; `tests/ode_parity.rs` verifies the local copy matches that hash before
comparing anything, so a stale or edited copy fails loudly.

To refresh after the upstream corpus changes:

```sh
cp ../pflow-xyz/parity/ode/{fixtures,expected}.json crates/pflow-solver/tests/fixtures/ode/
```

The same corpus is replayed by pflow-xyz's own `parity/ode/ode_parity_test.go`
(go-pflow, bit-exact) and `parity/ode/ode_expected_test.ts` (petri-solver.js,
1e-12 relative). pflow-rs is the third implementation held to it.
